script_text: Hold on, Sagittarius, Venus is sliding into a powerful conjunction with your ruling planet Jupiter right now. This fiery energy is lighting up your 9th House of adventure and higher learning. In love, a chance encounter with someone from a completely different background could spark a magnetic connection you did not see coming. For career and money, Venus in this position signals a generous surprise tied to travel, publishing, or an international opportunity in your 9th House. Be careful not to make grand promises to your partner tonight when emotions run this high. Subscribe so you do not miss what Jupiter has planned for you this week.
